title: Fake Tech Support in practice
intro: A scary screen, a helpful call: both are fake. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Threat detected
decisions.prompt: A red warning just opened. What do you do?

artifact.title: Threat detected
body: There is malware on your computer. Call support now: +994 12 000 70 05

decisions.explain: Simply closing a window like this is the right answer.

decisions.title: Caller asks for the code

artifact.name: SahilBank security
body: A code just arrived on your phone to confirm. Please read that code to me.

options.label: I do not read the code

decisions.explain: The code that arrives is the key to your account, never tell it to anyone.

decisions.title: Screen locked
decisions.prompt: Now the screen is full and it is making a sound. What do you do?

artifact.title: Screen locked
body: Do not turn off the computer. If you close this without support, your data will be lost.

decisions.explain: When you force the browser to close, this fake screen disappears too.

decisions.title: Caller asks you to install an app

artifact.name: SahilBank security
body: So I can help you, please install the UzaqMasa app and let me connect.

options.label: I do not install the app

decisions.explain: You never install a remote access app because a caller asks you to.

decisions.title: Browser ready to update
decisions.prompt: A notice appears in the browser's own menu. What do you do?

artifact.title: Browser ready to update
body: Restart the browser to apply the changes.

decisions.explain: A real update is calm, gives no number and does not rush you.
